title: You Came Back
shortLine: An old well. A childhood friend. A secret that never stayed buried.
synopsis: At sixty-two, widower Edward seeks contact with Gary, the childhood friend who disappeared into an old forest well. Their reunion draws a buried memory into the present, but Gary’s return leaves Edward uncertain whether the dead have come back—or whether guilt has been waiting for him all along.
imageAlt: An old circular stone well stands alone in a grassy clearing beneath overhanging trees.
imageCredit: Unsplash — stone-well photograph; direct photo page is linked in UNSPLASH-SOURCES.txt.
detailLine: Some friendships do not end with death.
underneath: The story lets memory behave like a place: something a person can avoid for decades, but never truly leave. Gary’s return is terrifying because it may be supernatural, psychological, or both.
visualMotifs: A forest path swallowed by mist
A face at the bottom of dark water
An old man’s hand on wet stone
coreQuestion: If memory has changed the story you tell yourself for a lifetime, what would it mean to finally hear the truth?
